checkpoints.summary: Defined the framework-independent canonical domain model for WU002: a closed-operator declarative Condition AST, and Zod-validated contracts for SourceDefinition/SourceVerification (kept separate per guardrails), DecisionReference, Provider/Channel, Requirement, and Step (task/wait/subjourney discriminated union).
completed: Added declarative Condition AST with a closed operator set (factEquals, factIn, factTruthy, factPresent, allOf, anyOf, not) and its Zod schema.
Added SourceDefinition and SourceVerification as separate Zod contracts.
Added DecisionReference contract linking to a SourceDefinition.
Added Provider and Channel contracts with a closed channel-type enum.
Added Requirement contract referencing Condition and DecisionReference ids.
Added Step contract as a discriminated union over task/wait/subjourney kinds; no 'blocked' state is stored on the step (routing derives actionability).
Added a domain model barrel export at src/domain/model/index.ts.
Added unit tests for every schema covering valid parses, closed-operator/enum rejection, and structural rejections.

validationCommands.summary: eslint . clean, including domain framework-independence rule.
next build succeeded (static export of existing pages, unaffected by domain-only change).

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: src/domain/model/** imports only zod; ESLint no-restricted-imports rule for src/domain/** passes.
30 passing Vitest cases across condition/source/decision/provider/requirement/step covering valid and invalid inputs.

checkpoints.summary: Implemented a pure, deterministic, framework-independent routing engine in src/domain/engine/ covering Condition evaluation, Route/RouteVariant selection, Step state derivation, Requirement/RequirementGroup resolution, and Destination resolution (next action, parallel work, waits, blocked, complete, subjourney recursion) per the accepted WU002 contracts.
completed: Condition evaluator (evaluateCondition, isApplicable, isFactTruthy) covering factEquals, factIn, factContains, factTruthy, factPresent, allOf, anyOf, not with missing-fact-as-absent semantics and explicit business truthiness (absent/false/0/""/[] => false).
Deterministic priority tie-break utility (sortByPriority/selectByPriority): priority desc, then declaration/reference order, then stable id.

Requirement/RequirementGroup resolver: applicable direct Requirement satisfied; non-applicable Requirement never blocks; allOf/anyOf composition over applicable members only; zero-applicable-members group never blocks; missing requirement/group references produce structured resolver evidence.

Route/RouteVariant selection (selectRoute): filters applicable Routes referenced by a Destination, selects by priority/order/id, resolves applicable RouteVariants for the winning Route with the same tie-break, falls back to the Route's own stepIds when no variant applies; missing route/variant references reported as evidence, not thrown.

Step state derivation (resolveStep): explicit states skipped/complete/blocked/actionable/waiting; task/manual and task/externalOutcome and wait/externalOutcome each gated by their own completion signal; dependsOnStepIds gating where a non-applicable dependency never blocks and a missing dependency reference does not block but is reported; requirement/group gating reuses the requirement resolver; wait steps can only reach skipped/complete/blocked/waiting, never actionable.

Destination resolution (resolveDestination): selects the route/variant, resolves every step, picks the highest-priority actionable task as the primary action (never a wait) with remaining actionable tasks as parallel actions, reports ready waits separately, falls through to blocked/complete/unresolved by the specified precedence, and recurses through subjourney steps preserving a parent/child destinationPath; subjourney and destination recursion is cycle-safe (visited-set guard) and reports a structured cycle issue instead of recursing infinitely.
Resolver evidence module (missingReference/cycleDetected) shared by every resolution stage so missing ids and cycles are deterministic structured output rather than crashes or silent pass-through.
Runtime progress/context types (RuntimeProgress, RoutingContext) as the minimum pure input WU003 needs; no persistence implemented (left to WU005).

Unit and fast-check property tests for every module (96 new tests): all 8 condition operators, absent facts, array membership, business truthiness, determinism and non-mutation invariants; route priority/tie-break/variant fallback; dependency satisfaction incl. non-applicable dependencies and missing references; direct requirements and allOf/anyOf groups; all three completion modes; blocked-never-actionable and wait-never-primary invariants; parallel actions; waiting-only and complete-only destination states; subjourney resolution and parent/child path; subjourney cycle safety; missing destination/step references; determinism and non-mutation of canonical content across repeated calls.

validationCommands.summary: 181 tests passed (96 new in src/domain/engine, 85 pre-existing unaffected).
No whitespace errors (line-ending notices only on pre-existing .aiqt state files).

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: condition.test.ts and priority.test.ts fast-check suites assert determinism, non-mutation, and structural invariants; destination.test.ts asserts repeated-call determinism and no mutation of graph/context inputs.

checkpoints.summary: Implemented WU004 Canonical Content & Validation: a src/content package with a ContentGraph aggregate schema over the WU002 entity contracts, cross-reference/condition/source/freshness validation (content:check), deterministic SHA-256 content hashing over a recursively key-sorted canonical form, and representative MVP content for J01 Moving home, J02 Electricity/gas, J03 Internet, and the Évora water resolver/module (modeled as its own subjourney-linked Destination). Content was authored from real, verified public sources (gov.pt/ePortugal, ERSE, ANACOM, Câmara Municipal de Évora) with SourceDefinition/SourceVerification kept separate per guardrails. Proved the content graph resolves correctly through the existing WU003 routing engine (subjourney gating, requirement-group blocking, condition-gated gas steps, RouteVariant portability path) via a dedicated integration test.
completed: Added src/content/graph.ts: strict ContentGraph aggregate schema composed from the WU002 entity schemas (no new entity shapes).
Added src/content/parse.ts: parseContentGraph shape-level validation wrapper.
Added src/content/hash.ts: deterministic SHA-256 content hash over a recursively key-sorted canonical JSON form; array order preserved as semantically meaningful.

Added src/content/validate.ts (content:check): duplicate-id, dangling-reference (across every entity relation including step->provider->channel), invalid-condition (blank fact key, walked through allOf/anyOf/not), missing-SourceVerification, and stale-high-freshness-risk-source checks. Link health is never treated as freshness proof.
Added src/content/index.ts: parses and exports the canonical content graph, its schema validation guard, and the deterministic contentHash.

Authored representative content under src/content/data/: sources.ts (SourceDefinition + SourceVerification, kept separate), decisions.ts (DecisionReference provenance for decision-bearing rules), providers.ts, requirements.ts, evoraWater.ts (Évora water resolver/module: requirement-gated task + wait, its own Route/Destination), moveHome.ts (J01, with a fact-gated subjourney into the Évora water module), energy.ts (J02, gas steps conditioned on household.hasGasConnection), internet.ts (J03, RouteVariant for ANACOM number portability), and index.ts assembling the full ContentGraph.

Wired pnpm content:check to a Vitest-based check (src/content/check.test.ts) since the project has no ts-node/tsx runner; reuses already-approved tooling instead of adding a dependency outside WU004 scope.

Added unit tests: parse.test.ts, hash.test.ts (determinism, key-order independence, array-order sensitivity, change sensitivity), validate.test.ts (one test per issue kind plus edge cases: latest-verification-wins for staleness, link-health-does-not-imply-freshness).

Added src/content/integration.test.ts: resolves every representative Destination through the real WU003 engine (resolveDestination) across multiple fact/progress scenarios, asserting zero resolver issues and correct actionable/blocked state, including the Évora subjourney gating and the internet portability RouteVariant.
Removed src/content/.gitkeep (superseded by real content).

issues.title: Single Route per Destination in this representative slice
issues.description: Only one Route is declared per Destination in this representative slice (no RouteVariant besides the J03 portability path); alternate-channel variants (e.g. in-person vs online paths with different requirements) were not modeled because the researched sources did not describe channel-specific requirement differences. Not a defect against WU004 scope, but a known content-depth limitation for a future content WU.

issues.title: Évora water source has a single recorded verification
issues.description: The Évora water source (source.cm-evora-aguas-contratos) is declared high freshnessRisk with only a single recorded SourceVerification; content:check correctly requires this source's verification history to be refreshed on a real content-review cadence going forward, which is an operational/process concern outside this WU's scope, not a code gap.

vitest run src/content/check.test.ts: 3/3 passed -- representative content has zero cross-reference/condition/source/freshness issues, and the content hash is deterministic (repeat computation and key-order independence).

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: pnpm content:check passes with zero issues from checkContentGraph over the assembled J01/J02/J03/Évora-water content; the integration test further shows the same content resolves correctly through the real WU003 engine with zero resolver issues across multiple fact/progress scenarios.

checkpoints.summary: Implemented a versioned browser-local persisted-state envelope, a testable storage-adapter boundary, migration/reset handling, and content-version-mismatch revalidation, plus a Next.js hydration boundary that never reads localStorage during server rendering.
completed: Defined the persisted-state envelope schema (schemaVersion, contentVersion, updatedAt, sessions) and the PersistedSession/PersistedRuntimeProgress shapes in src/persistence/schema.ts, mirroring WU003's RuntimeProgress as the single routing-state model.

Implemented a StorageAdapter interface plus an InMemoryStorageAdapter for tests (src/persistence/storageAdapter.ts) and a browser LocalStorageAdapter (src/persistence/localStorageAdapter.ts), isolating the only module allowed to touch window.localStorage.

Implemented pure load/save/reset logic (src/persistence/state.ts) with explicit outcomes for empty, malformed JSON, schema-invalid data, unsupported schema versions, and storage-unavailable failures -- never throwing.

Implemented deterministic content-version revalidation (src/persistence/revalidate.ts, src/persistence/contentIndex.ts): a session whose root Destination no longer exists is discarded; step/requirement ids that no longer exist in current content are dropped from progress rather than trusted; the envelope is re-stamped with the current contentVersion after successful revalidation.
Implemented the orchestration entry point (src/persistence/resume.ts) composing load -> migrate -> revalidate -> (re)save into one deterministic outcome with an explicit ResumeReason.
Implemented progress (de)serialization between the persisted array shape and WU003's RuntimeProgress set shape (src/persistence/progress.ts), with deterministic (sorted) serialization.

Implemented the Next.js/browser hydration boundary as a useHydratedSession hook (src/persistence/react/useHydratedSession.ts) built on useSyncExternalStore, so the server snapshot and the client's initial render both resolve to an identical 'loading' state and the real localStorage read only happens after hydration completes.

Updated docs/governance/versioning.md with the persisted schema version vs content version distinction, migration/reset policy, content-mismatch revalidation, the browser-local/no-login boundary, and the no-raw-free-text-persistence rule.

Added tests covering all 14 required scenarios: valid round trip, malformed JSON, schema-invalid data, unsupported schema version, explicit reset, contentVersion match/mismatch, stale step/requirement ids not surviving as trusted progress, valid progress preserved, parent/subjourney progress round trip, storage unavailable/read/write failure, server-side no-localStorage-access, and deterministic serialization.

validationCommands.summary: 289 tests passed across 26 test files (vitest run), including all 14 required WU005 scenarios.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Runtime state is versioned and safe to resume.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: PersistedStateEnvelope carries schemaVersion/contentVersion; loadPersistedState/resumePersistedState never throw on malformed JSON, schema-invalid data, unsupported schema versions, or storage failures, and fall back to a safe fresh envelope in every case (state.test.ts, resume.test.ts).

revalidateEnvelope/resumePersistedState detect a contentVersion mismatch, discard sessions whose root Destination no longer exists, drop stale step/requirement ids from progress, and re-stamp the envelope with the current contentVersion (revalidate.test.ts, resume.test.ts).
